mapper.select: select T1.statusBatch,T1.account,T1.assetId,T1.holdShares,T1.holdQtyAmount,T1.bankMark,T1.dateStatus,T1.groupId FROM (select '1' AS statusBatch, PROD_ID AS account, ASSET_ID AS assetId, POS_AMT AS holdShares, TDY_COST_AMT AS holdQtyAmount, '91110000100011743X' AS bankMark , ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by PROD_ID,ASSET_ID order by VALUE_DATE desc ) monthMarkNo, STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') AS dateStatus, DATA_SOURCE AS groupId From CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA where VALUE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')AND STATUS !='D')T1 where monthMarkNo = 1
